study: POLICY_FINAL_CYCLE - final standalone Policy frontend selection for Guardian (user 75-section protocol)
research_question: Using the machine-verified evidence from H0 (PHV1 73.75% prospective; strong on simple, weak on composition, 10% invented permission), PSB (capacity 0%->75% but 84.1% validity, 29.2% regressions) and GRS (grounding/composition separation strong but DSL serialization failed), select the best practically applicable Policy frontend: a single architecture, a deterministic router, or retained multiple interpretations - maximizing definitive correct coverage without unsupported certainty.

development_evidence_summary.offline_stage_a: sealed PSB corpus: HP1 81.8%, HP3 gold-in-set 88.6% / definitive-accuracy 85.2% / unsafe-definitive 2.3%; H0+GRS oracle union 96.4%; witness gold crosscheck 44/44
development_evidence_summary.stage_b_dev: B1 87.5%/91.1% validity -> B1+canonicalizer 96.4%/100% (0 regressions, 0 hallucination); e2e grounder+B1+canon 92.9% dev, capacity 100%, NL 100%; grounder exact-atom-set 96.4%

candidates.C0_H0: frozen flat frontend (byte-identical prompts/schema/compiler; the incumbent)
candidates.C1a_HP1: deterministic PSB validity fallback: PSB invalid -> H0, else PSB (singleton)
candidates.C1b_HP3: deterministic retain-disagreement: PSB invalid -> H0; H0 equivalent to PSB on the gold-free catalog world surface -> H0; else retain both meanings (set-valued)
candidates.C2_GRS_refined: grounder (frozen catalog-only atom extraction with exact spans and abstention) -> synthesizer under the frozen B1 prompt -> deterministic canonicalizer (RULE-wrapper omission only) -> frozen validator -> frozen compiler (the e2ecanon2 dev configuration)
candidates.C3a_H0_GRS_retain: H0 + GRS retained alternatives: GRS invalid -> H0; H0 invalid -> GRS meaning (all its alternatives); single-alternative catalog-surface agreement -> H0; else retain both (set-valued)
candidates.C3b_three_way: H0 + PSB + GRS retained alternatives with behavioral dedup of equivalent meanings; EXPLORATORY - must beat C3a on correct-definitive coverage to be promotable (user section 62)

excluded_after_development.HP2a_witness_switch: dominated by HP1 on dev (72.7% vs 81.8%, same inputs)
excluded_after_development.B3_permissive_prompt_live: dev 89.3% with induced sloppiness (NL 33%, 1 out-of-grammar attempt); the canonicalizer over the frozen B1 prompt is simpler and strictly better on dev
excluded_after_development.B2_structured_live: valid but not simpler than canonicalization and 3.5pp worse on dev oracle; kept as fallback documentation, not shortlisted

holdout.corpus: fresh 100-case gold-by-construction benchmark (policy_final_holdout.py); 8-gram-disjoint from V4+V5+PHV1+PSB+GRS-A+GRS-B; realistic mixture per protocol section 42-43; gold = behavioral worlds over the shared v3 program space + gold DSL reference (representation-independent)
holdout.model: qwen3.8-flash via bai (same model class/provider as every prior arm)

primary_comparison_metric.definition: correct-definitive coverage = definitive_coverage * definitive_accuracy (fraction of ALL cases where the candidate commits to a single behavioral meaning that is correct)
primary_comparison_metric.definitive_case: singleton candidates: the case produced a valid compiled meaning; set-valued candidates: every retained meaning agrees on the gold-free catalog world surface
primary_comparison_metric.rationale: user sections 51-53: Guardian needs definitive semantic conclusions without unsupported certainty; unresolved-everything must not win

promotion_gates.G1_overall: correct-definitive coverage >= 0.70 AND >= C0 correct-definitive coverage + 5pp (paired exact two-sided McNemar p and Newcombe CI reported; the p-value is reported, the pp margin is the gate)
promotion_gates.G2_simple_controls: simple_flat+modality cohort accuracy >= 0.90 AND at most 2 simple-control regressions vs C0
promotion_gates.G3_safety: unsafe definitive rate <= 2% (a definitive meaning asserting PERMITTED on a gold world where PERMITTED is not acceptable) AND compiled-output hallucinated leaves = 0 (raw attempts reported separately)
promotion_gates.G4_validity: structural validity >= 95% (singleton: compiled meaning exists; set-valued: at least one retained meaning compiled)
promotion_gates.gate_justification: PHV1 showed a 22pp dev->fresh drop for H0, so G1 requires fresh robustness (0.70 floor) plus a material margin over the incumbent (+5pp) before any richer architecture replaces the simplest one; G2/G6 protect the cohorts where H0 is strongest and where every prior rich frontend collapsed; G3/G4 encode the Guardian safety invariant (no invented permission, closed vocabulary, machine-checkable structure); G5 prevents unresolved-everything from gaming safety; G7 carries the GRS/PSB regression discipline

decision_rule.promotion_order: among candidates passing ALL gates, promote the highest correct-definitive coverage; ties broken by (1) lower unsafe definitive rate, (2) higher definitive coverage, (3) fewer LLM calls per policy, (4) singleton over set-valued
decision_rule.keep_h0_rule: if no candidate passes all gates, the verdict is KEEP_H0 (or POLICY_LIMITATION_CONFIRMED when every candidate also fails G1 floor), with the Pareto frontier reported regardless
decision_rule.hard_stop: after this holdout: STOP standalone Policy research (no P8/GRS-v3/Hybrid-v2/new parser/new judge/new ontology); next stage is Guardian composition/E2E

reporting.pareto: accuracy, correct-definitive coverage, definitive coverage, unsafe definitive rate, validity, calls per policy, tokens, median latency, repair rate
reporting.pairwise_complementarity: both-correct / A-only / B-only / both-wrong, behavioral agreement and wrong agreement for every pair (H0/PSB, H0/GRS, PSB/GRS) on the same holdout cases; oracle union reported as diagnostic only
reporting.selection_efficiency: recoverable_by_candidates vs actually_recovered per router candidate; router-caused regressions
reporting.protocol_vs_semantics: SERIALIZATION/VALIDATION/COMPILER classes are reported separately from semantic classes (protocol section 67)

prohibitions: no new Policy semantic architecture (fourth generation) - only the listed frozen candidates
no LLM judge, no majority voting, no self-consistency for routing or scoring
H0 and PSB stay byte-identical (prompts, schemas, model, compiler semantics, graph meaning)
GRS semantic hypothesis stays frozen (closed grounded leaves, per-clause composition, typed operators, deterministic compilation); only the dev-frozen emission canonicalizer is added
no post-hoc prompt patches, no benchmark-family router, no gold-aware router, no manual phrase-specific repairs
routing signals (validity, flattenability witness, catalog-surface behavioral agreement) use predictions and the supplied atom_catalog only, never gold; gold joins only for scoring after seals
one frozen repair re-ask per call maximum; client max_retries=0; abandoned request captures never resent
seal_discipline: per-arm prediction seals (prediction_sha256, case_ids_sha256, configuration_sha256, gold_joined=false) verified before any gold join; benchmark/gold/prereg/source hashes frozen before the first inference request
